title: Marcos: China ‘use of force’ remark sounds ‘very much like a threat’
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said Friday that the remarks of China's ambassador that Beijing could “easily win” a conflict with the Philippines sounded “very much to me like a threat.”
